test_title: SSC CPO Tier-II Previous Year Paper (Held On: 26th July 2021)
subject: general
question: **Directions: Select the misspelt word.**
solution:
The correct answer is 'relevent' i.e. this word is misspelled.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let us explore the options:-

 
 
• Relevent: There is no such word in English or we can say that there is some spelling mistake in this word.

 
 
• The correct spelling is 'Relevant' and it means **important and useful**. (महत्वपूर्ण और उपयोगी)
 
 
 
• Distinct means **clearly different**. (स्‍पष्‍टतया भिन्‍न)
 
• Beseech means **to ask somebody for something in a worried way because you want or need it very much**. (अनुनय करना, विनती करना, विनतीपूर्वक मांगना)
 
• Surrender means **to stop fighting and admit that you have lost**. (लड़ना बंद कर अपनी हार मान लेना, आत्‍मसमर्पण कर देना)

 
 
 

Hence, the correct answer is option 1.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Example of 'Relevant' in a____ sentence__:

 
 
• ***Relevant** documents were presented in court*.
